title: Config rollback caused cache invalidation storm
summary: Rollback of feature flag config triggered mass cache invalidation. Config service overwhelmed.
rootCause: Config rollback broadcast changed config to all clients simultaneously; each client invalidated local caches and re-fetched, creating thundering herd.

aiAnalysis.summary: Config rollback without staggered rollout caused cache stampede on config-service.
aiAnalysis.rootCause: Rollback pushed config change to all 200+ clients at once. Each client's cache TTL expired around the same time (deployed in same batch), causing synchronized re-fetch storm. Config-service CPU hit 100%, latency spiked to 2s.
recommendations: Implement staggered config rollout (canary by region or pod subset)
Add jitter to cache TTL to spread re-fetch load
Consider long-polling or push-based config instead of pull
Add rate limiting to config-service per client
